narrative.details:
I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... sad.

I know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
narrative.objectives: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in Forest Song.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, kind friend. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
narrative.requestItemsText: Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.
